facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary PFS endpoint by BICR; secondary endpoints positive · Phase 3 · firmonertinib in first-line EGFR exon 20 NSCLC · not yet approved
facts.indication: first-line EGFR exon 20 insertion mutant non-small cell lung cancer

evidence.summary: the FURVENT (NCT05607550) Phase 3 trial evaluating firmonertinib monotherapy in patients with previously untreated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations did not meet its primary endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not meet its primary endpoint of progression free survival (PFS) by blinded independent central review (BICR)
evidence.safety: The safety profile observed in FURVENT was consistent with previous clinical studies of firmonertinib, with no new safety signals identified.
